title: Mean time to respond — containment (isolation MTTR)
summary: Time between playbook ingest of a confirmed ransomware signal and successful endpoint containment (EDR isolate succeeded, or the network-ACL fallback dropped). Measures the containment loop end-to-end — the operational hinge most ransomware playbooks rise or fall on. Lower is better.

target.rationale: Internal goal: confirmed-event-to-isolation under 30 minutes, before encryption typically completes.

measurement.formula: p95( isolation.succeeded_at - triage_signal.started_at ) over confirmed ransomware events in window, where isolation.succeeded_at is taken from whichever branch (EDR isolate or network-ACL fallback) terminated successfully.

inputs.name: triage_started
inputs.description: start time of the triage-signal step

inputs.name: isolation_edr
inputs.description: completion time of the EDR-isolate branch

inputs.name: isolation_fallback
inputs.description: completion time of the network-ACL deny fallback branch

external_refs.name: DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 17 — ICT-related incident management
